name: Gond Ladoo
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and fry the edible gum (gond) until it puffs up; remove and crush coarsely.
2. In the same ghee, roast whole wheat flour on low heat until golden brown and aromatic.
3. Add dry ginger powder, crushed gond, grated coconut, melon seeds, and chopped nuts to the flour mixture.
4. Melt jaggery in a separate pan with a little ghee to form a syrup; do not overcook.
5. Pour the jaggery syrup into the flour mixture, stir quickly to combine.
6. While the mixture is still warm, grease your palms with ghee and roll small portions into firm, round ladoos.
description: Gond Ladoo is a highly nutritious, energy-boosting traditional sweet from Haryana, widely consumed during the harsh winter months to provide warmth and strength. It is culturally significant as a post-partum restorative food for nursing mothers and a seasonal health supplement for the entire family.
